harnesses.checks.py:
import subprocess,json,time
from pathlib import Path
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
r=[]
steps=[('debug-build',['make','debug','CC=clang']),('debug-core',['make','check','CC=clang']),('interop',['make','check-interop']),('sanitizers',['make','check-sanitize','CC=clang']),('verified-release',['make','verified-release','CC=clang']),('release-core',['make','check','CC=clang']),('complete-files',['python3','test/pcm_equivalence.py','--reference',str(B/'baseline'),'--candidate','./wavegain','--output',str(B/'complete-files.json')]),('x64-kernels',['python3','test/loudness_kernels.py','--cc','clang -arch x86_64','--cflags=-O2','--output',str(B/'x64-oracle.json')]),('O3-kernels',['python3','test/loudness_kernels.py','--cc','clang','--cflags=-O3 -flto=thin','--output',str(B/'O3-oracle.json')])]
for name,cmd in steps:
    start=time.perf_counter()
    with (B/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:q=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    r.append({'name':name,'command':cmd,'exit_code':q.returncode,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start});(B/'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(name,q.returncode,round(r[-1]['seconds'],2),flush=True)
    if q.returncode:
        print((B/(name+'.log')).read_text()[-5000:]);raise SystemExit(q.returncode)
harnesses.apply_bench.py:
import subprocess,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
while True:
    try:r=json.loads((B/'final-results.json').read_text())
    except (FileNotFoundError,json.JSONDecodeError):r={'runs':[]}
    if len(r['runs'])==21:break
    time.sleep(1)
S=Path('/private/tmp/wavegain-native-study/source-f32.w64');P=Path('/private/tmp/wavegain-csharp-comparison/csharp/Probe.dll')
R={'method':'One sequential full-program run each, order baseline/final/C#. Fresh analysis and float W64 output; process launch and file I/O included. Native includes output TP verification; C# does not. Common C# output measurement and SHA outside timers. Outputs removed after verification; source unchanged.','runs':[]}
for name in ['baseline','final','csharp']:
    dest=B/'apply-output.w64';assert not dest.exists()
    start=time.perf_counter()
    if name=='csharp':
        plan=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['dotnet',str(P),'--apply-plan',str(S),str(dest),'-18','-2'],text=True))
        q=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error',*plan['ffmpeg_arguments']],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    else:
        q=subprocess.run([str(B/name),'-y','-p','--target-lufs','-18','--peak-ceiling','-2','-b','5','--output',str(dest),str(S)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
    print('apply',name,round(elapsed,4),'measurement follows outside timer',flush=True)
    measure=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['dotnet',str(P),str(dest),'-18','-2'],text=True))
    assert measure['frames']==510385136
    digest=hashlib.file_digest(dest.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
    R['runs'].append({'implementation':name,'seconds':elapsed,'measurement':measure,'file_sha256':digest,'stdout':q.stdout,'stderr':q.stderr})
    (B/'apply-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(R,indent=2)+'\n')
    dest.unlink()
assert R['runs'][0]['file_sha256']==R['runs'][1]['file_sha256'],'Native output bytes changed!'
print('Native full-program output files match exactly; C# common measurements recorded.',flush=True)

screening_tradeoff: The coarse exact bound benefits this real program; on the continuously loud synthetic kernel workload screening adds overhead relative to the same optimized build with WG_TP_FULL_INTERPOLATION. Overall speed remains substantially above the pre-change baseline. Not a universal speed guarantee.
limitations: Single Mac and single real title; warm caches, three analysis repetitions; one application run per implementation.
Native x64 Windows/MSVC and Linux performance not measured; Rosetta validates x64 arithmetic only.
No final AAC encode or original-video extraction in these timings. Native output TP verification retained; C# apply omits it.
Official EBU/ITU conformance corpus remains a separate open validation item.
Exploratory s16 timing overlapped validation and is excluded; only final isolated runs support the conclusions.
